risks.title: Oil and Gas Price Volatility
risks.score_rationale: WTI oil prices for 2025 were down approximately 15% compared to prior year. Oil and gas price fluctuations directly impact royalty revenues and net income given the company's concentrated exposure in Permian Basin operations. (score par défaut, à affiner)
risks.summary: Volatility in crude oil and natural gas prices materially impacts royalty revenues and financial performance.

risks.title: Permian Basin Production Dependency
risks.score_rationale: TPL's revenue is substantially dependent on oil and gas production decisions by operators in the Permian Basin. Reduced production activity would negatively impact royalty revenues. (score par défaut, à affiner)
risks.summary: Heavy reliance on Permian Basin operator production decisions for revenue generation exposes company to production risk.

risks.title: Regulatory and Environmental Risk
risks.score_rationale: Operations are subject to environmental and energy regulations. Regulatory changes could increase compliance costs or impact operational ability to generate revenues. (score par défaut, à affiner)
risks.summary: Subject to environmental and energy regulatory requirements that may impact costs and operations.

risks.title: Credit Facility Risk
risks.score_rationale: Company established a $500 million revolving credit facility in October 2025 with maturity in 2029. No borrowings had been drawn as of December 31, 2025, but future borrowings could increase financial leverage. (score par défaut, à affiner)
risks.summary: Company has access to $500 million revolving credit facility established October 2025, undrawn as of year-end.

risks.title: Market Competition
risks.score_rationale: TPL operates in a competitive energy market with other royalty and non-operating companies competing for assets, operations, and investment opportunities. (score par défaut, à affiner)
risks.summary: Competitive exposure in mineral rights and energy sector may impact acquisition opportunities and returns.

risks.title: Environmental and Climate Risk
risks.score_rationale: Oil and gas production activities carry inherent environmental risks including potential accidents, spills, and contamination that could damage reputation and reduce revenues. (score par défaut, à affiner)
risks.summary: Environmental risks inherent in oil and gas production operations could negatively impact reputation and financial performance.

company_description: Texas Pacific Land Corporation engages in the land and resource management, and water services and operations businesses. The Land and Resource Management segment manages surface acres of land, and oil and gas royalty interest in Permian Basin. This segment also engages in easements, such as transporting oil, gas and related hydrocarbons, power line and utility, and subsurface wellbore easements. In addition, this segment leases its land for processing, storage, and compression facilities and roads; and is involved in sale of materials, such as caliche, sand, and other material, as well as sells land. The Water Services and Operations segment provides full-service water offerings, including water sourcing, produced-water treatment, infrastructure development, and disposal solutions to operators in the Permian Basin. This segment also holds produced water royalties. The company owns a 1/128th nonparticipating perpetual oil and gas royalty interest (NPRI) under approximately 85,000 acres of land; a 1/16th NPRI under approximately 371,000 acres of land; and approximately 33,000 additional net royalty acres, total of approximately 224,000 NRA located in the Permian Basin.
